title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 77-80 (Bhaskari, Bilvanilaya, Vararoha, Yashasvini)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 77 to 80: Bhaskari, Bilvanilaya, Vararoha, Yashasvini, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 77 to 80 with meaning
caption: Names 77 to 80 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 77 to 80**: **Bhaskari, Bilvanilaya, Vararoha, Yashasvini**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Bhaskari, Bilvanilaya, Vararoha, Yashasvini.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Bhaskari** means **Radiant like the sun**. Sri Suktam says 'adityavarne': she shines with the colour of the sun.

sections.h: Bilvanilaya: Dweller in the bilva tree
p: **Bilvanilaya** means **Dweller in the bilva tree**. Tradition: when Vishnu ran short of offerings for Shiva, Lakshmi created the bilva tree (Skanda Purana).
**Vararoha** means **Graceful in form**. The name praises her noble, graceful form.
**Yashasvini** means **The Glorious One**. Glorious: fame and a good name come with her grace.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
